name: Barbarian (Tank)
desc: Focuses on heavy lifting, strength training, and maximum power output.
lore: Masters of raw power. When others rest, Barbarians add another plate.

name: Rogue (Speed)
desc: Focuses on running, sprinting, and high-intensity interval training (HIIT).
lore: Fleet-footed and relentless. The open road is their training ground.

name: Monk (Agility)
desc: Focuses on bodyweight exercises, calisthenics, yoga, and flexibility.
lore: The body is the weapon. Discipline forged through movement and stillness.

name: Paladin (Balanced)
desc: A balanced protocol mixing strength, cardio, and endurance.
lore: Neither purely powerful nor purely fast — the Paladin masters all domains.

name: Ranger (Endurance)
desc: Long-distance running, cycling, and sustained outdoor challenges.
lore: Hours of relentless movement through any terrain. Distance is their domain.

name: Wizard (Precision)
desc: Technical lifting, Olympic weightlifting, and sport-specific movement patterns.
lore: Form is everything. Mastery comes from the relentless pursuit of perfect technique.
